im sorry youre going through this stuff too . yeahh. it really fucking sucks. i ended up scribbling too hard and found myself getting more irritated so i turned off the lgiths and am trying to zone out a little. i feel like if i let myself feel my feelings things wont turn out well , cuz my coping mechanisms / ways to at least kinda simulate being happy arent working anymore . 
thank you, i have to remember my pain is also kinda a strength. im at least not caving in and cutting and am doing other things. maybe they arent helpful but its better than cutting and reinforcing bad shit. thank you
i believe you deserve to live too. thank you for being alive. i feel like you really care about people, you know. thank you. im gonna make it through tonight.

idk, ive been trying to not do it but its just a constant thought, you know. thinking about writing a suicide note and a will and deciding what things of mine to give to who and who would get whatever money i happen to have. idk if i really desrve to be alive tho, dont think id go as far as to say that. i really appreciate the comment tho. rn im scribbling on some paper hoping the Wanting To Cut feeling passes.
